title: FemWear: A Parameter-Efficient Wearable Foundation Model for Women's Health
abstract: arXiv:2608.08244v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: General-purpose wearable foundation models are pretrained on broad sensor streams and populations, but their representations are not organized around women's health. FemWear is a women's wearable foundation model, obtained by parameter-efficiently repurposing a pretrained general multimodal wearable backbone into a specialized representation for women's health. It keeps the pretrained patch projection and Transformer encoder frozen and trains 239,236 encoder parameters - 1.11% of a 21.54M-parameter encoder - through low-rank residual adapters and causal task-family heads, producing one shared longitudinal representation for menstrual, symptom, affective, sleep/recovery, autonomic, activity, and pregnancy outcomes. We evaluate six cohorts with 63 comparable primary metrics, 33 from women's-health cohorts, while retaining the 32-task OpenMHC ability-retention benchmark. translated_title: FemWear：一个面向女性健康的参数高效可穿戴基础模型
translated_abstract: 通用可穿戴基础模型在广泛的传感器数据流和人群上进行预训练，但其表示并未围绕女性健康进行组织。FemWear是一个女性可穿戴基础模型，通过参数高效的方式，将预训练的通用多模态可穿戴骨干网络改造为面向女性健康的专用表示。该方法保持预训练的补丁投影和Transformer编码器冻结，仅通过低秩残差适配器和因果任务族头训练239,236个编码器参数——仅占2154万参数编码器的1.11%——从而为月经、症状、情感、睡眠/恢复、自主神经、活动和妊娠结果等任务产生一个共享的纵向表示。研究者在六个队列上使用63个可比较的主要指标进行评估，其中33个来自女性健康队列，同时保留了包含32个任务的OpenMHC能力保持基准。在固定的参与者划分上、跨三个随机种子的评估中，FemWear提升了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: FemWear通过冻结预训练编码器、仅用低秩残差适配器训练1.11%的参数，将通用可穿戴基础模型高效改造为面向女性健康的专用基础模型，在月经、症状、睡眠、妊娠等女性健康任务上取得提升，同时保留原有通用能力。
en_tdlr: FemWear is a parameter-efficient wearable foundation model for women's health that fine-tunes only 1.11% of encoder parameters via low-rank adapters on a frozen pretrained backbone, improving women's health outcomes while retaining general-purpose abilities.
